I tend to not get worked up over losing or winning anymore. For me it boils down to a few main points:

  • it doesn't help my enjoyment of the game
  • it doesn't make me play any better (and I'll usually start making stupid mistakes when I'm frustrated)
  • I can't always control the game, but I can control how I react to the game
  • both winning and losing are both part of the gameplay
